rationale: A real, documented breach event (Fireworks AI → Notion AI → end-user workspaces, November 2026) concretely surfaces the structural gap: enterprises using AI-augmented SaaS have no visibility into sub-processor security posture until breach notification arrives by email. The buyer (compliance/security officers at SOC 2/GDPR-obligated companies) already pays for tools like Vanta, Drata, and SecurityScorecard, confirming budget and willingness-to-pay for exactly this category of continuous monitoring. Pain frequency is monthly in the sense that AI sub-processor relationships are being created continuously across the SaaS ecosystem, creating recurring exposure; acute incidents like this one recur several times per year across the broader vendor landscape.
